system.one_liner: Shows that SSMs trained on interactive tool-use trajectories generalise to much larger problems than the training length, unlike when trained on single-turn tool use.

content.variant_note: three agent strategies drawn as columns of typed trajectory boxes, with one result chart beside them
content.argues: Mamba generalises to far larger codebases when trained to imitate interactive tool-using agents, but not when trained on single-turn tool use.
content.subject: Three ways of collecting coding-agent trajectories (single-turn, interactive, distilled SWE-agent) and a chart of Mamba and Pythia pass rates against codebase size.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw each agent policy as a column of colour-typed boxes (instruction grey, command orange, output green, thought blue) with commands flush left and outputs indented, and put the result chart beside the columns with legend numbers matching the column headings.

evidence: Hard-coded agent that iteratively runs the code, changes a few files, runs the code again
Models are trained on codebases of up to 16 files (dashed red line), with context length 8,192
Mamba displays favorable performance on large codebases when trained to imitate interactive agents (agents 2 and 3)

summary: The paper shows that state space models, which have fixed-size memory, can generalise to much longer problems when they use tools interactively. Figure 1 sets three tool-use agents beside a result chart. Three columns show excerpts of real trajectories for a code-fixing task: a single-turn agent that prints all files and then edits, an interactive agent that runs code, reads tracebacks and edits again, and an SWE-agent 32B whose instruction, messages, commands and outputs are distilled. Orange boxes are commands, green boxes tool output, blue italic bubbles the agent's messages. On the right a line chart of pass rate against number of functions compares Mamba-1.4b and Pythia-1.4b under each strategy, with a dashed line at the training limit of 16 functions.
summary_zh: 状态空间模型借助交互式工具调用可泛化到更长的问题。图并排三种智能体的真实轨迹节选（单轮、交互式、蒸馏自 SWE-agent），橙色是命令、绿色是输出；右侧折线图比较 Mamba 与 Pythia 的通过率，虚线为训练上限 16 个函数。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The numbers 1-3 name strategies and are not step markers. The hand-on-keyboard icon is taken to be the single placed bitmap (18x18 pt). Verdict 'fails' for strategy 1 follows the caption and text (Mamba fails on complex codebases when trained single-turn).
